article.title: 更進新聞：ChatGPT Space向Plus推出，分享仍需帳戶資格
article.title_en: Update: ChatGPT Space rolls out to Plus with restricted sharing
article.summary: OpenAI開始向全球18歲以上Plus使用者推出Space，將互動頁面與簡報協作擴至更多帳戶。
article.summary_en: OpenAI began a global Space rollout to Plus users aged 18 and older, widening access to interactive pages and presentation collaboration.
highlights: 收件人需有瀏覽權限，並登入具Space資格的付費帳戶。
Free使用者不能開啟分享頁面，現階段沒有公開連結。
highlights_en: Recipients need viewing permission and a paid account with Space access.
Free users cannot open shared pages, and public links are unavailable.
article.why: 代理商可重新評估哪些客戶能在Space共同修改簡報，並按收件人的帳戶資格決定交付形式。
article.why_en: Agencies can assess which clients can collaborate in Space and choose delivery formats around recipient access.
article.next_step: 在一份客戶簡報開始協作前，先確認雙方帳戶已有Space及頁面權限，再測試收件人能否開啟該頁。
article.next_step_en: Confirm both accounts have Space and page permission, then test whether the recipient can open a shared client brief.
article.detail: Space可建立互動頁面及簡報，也可按已連接工具的資料安排內容更新。這次的新進展是Plus資格擴展，並非首次推出整套功能。側欄的Space會取代Library作為檔案與頁面的入口；團隊可先選一份需要共同修改的材料，確認參與者資格後再安排後續更新。
article.detail_en: Space supports interactive pages, slides and updates from connected tools. The incremental event is Plus access rather than the first launch of all features. Space replaces Library as the file and page entry point. Start with one collaborative brief after confirming participants' eligibility.
article.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
article.followup: 9月30日版已報道Pages及Space投入使用；11月20日更新擴展Plus接入資格，原有分享限制仍需核對。
article.followup_en: Our September 30 issue covered Pages and Space in production. The November 20 update expands Plus access, with sharing limits still applying.
